channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran’s president says Khamenei is in ‘perfect health’
item.description: Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian says Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei had a message of “unity and cohesion”

item.title: Colombia earthquake live: Magnitude 7.4 quake strikes near Bogota; 69 dead
item.description: Officials say at least 69 people have been killed in the quake, with some still trapped under rubble.

item.title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 30
item.description: Donald Trump says the US is only ‘semi-negotiating’ with Iran.

item.title: Iran changed the rules in Hormuz. The Gulf is changing the rules for Iran
item.description: Iran gained leverage in Hormuz, but its neighbours are reshaping regional security to limit what Tehran can do with it.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
item.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack - one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

item.title: Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word
item.description: The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.

item.title: Alleged rebel leader killed in Colombia as president targets armed groups
item.description: The military operation against Hernando Forero Mosquera was carried out just days after Colombia's new president was sworn in.

item.title: Battle for Mali base has killed dozens of militants, army says
item.description: The army says it was involved in fierce fighting but disputes that Islamists took control of the garrison.
